highlights: Redmi Watch 5 ActiveThe new premium-looking Redmi Watch 5 Active comes with a metallic finish dial and advanced locking of the strap making it convenient to wear. The watch is loaded with features that are:
Bluetooth v5.3 (BLE), 3 mic ENC and speaker
Large 5.08cm(2.0) Bright Display with 500nits peak brightness,320 x 385 resolution
Advanced Health Monitoring with 24*7 Heart Rate Monitoring, 24*7 SpO2 Monitoring, Stress Monitoring, Sleep Tracker
Period Cycle Monitoring for females to keep track of their health
Up to 18 days of large battery life with typical usage and up to 12 days of battery life with heavy usage
200+ customizable watch faces covering multiple categories like formal, activity, mechanical, cartoon, and many more. You can customize your own watch face as well
140+ sports and workout mode- Automatic Sports Detection available for 6 types of sports modes only - Indoor running, outdoor running, walking, elliptical machine, rowing machine, skipping rope.
